description: Generate a GitHub-ready pull-request title and Markdown body from a completed MartinLoop run dossier, including its verification grade and score. Use after a governed run completes when you need PR copy without creating the PR. Use martin_create_pr instead to actually open the PR on GitHub. Use martin_review_pr to evaluate an existing PR body against run evidence. Use martin_eval first if you need a merge-readiness grade before generating the PR body. This tool only reads saved run evidence and does not modify the repository or contact GitHub.

file.description: Absolute or relative path to a loop-record.json file or run directory. Mutually exclusive with loopId and latest.

format.description: Dossier rendering format. Defaults to github-pr for PR body generation. Use md for plain Markdown or json for structured output.

latest.description: When true, generates the summary for the most recently updated run. Mutually exclusive with file and loopId.

loopId.description: MartinLoop run identifier from the run store. Mutually exclusive with file and latest.

runsDir.description: Override the default run-store root directory. Optional.

name: martin_pr_summary

body.description: GitHub-flavoured Markdown PR body containing the run dossier.

grade.description: Verification grade assigned to the run.

loopId.description: MartinLoop run identifier used to generate the summary.
